title: MatchEvent
description: One synthetic match event. Coordinates are metres on a 105x68 pitch, normalised so the acting team attacks left to right.

id.description: Unique, stable event id, e.g. e1042

t.description: Match clock in seconds since kickoff of the first half (34:26 = 2066)

player_id.description: Acting player; null for match-level events

type.description: Restart types (throw_in, goal_kick, corner, free_kick, penalty) mark the moment the restart is AWARDED (ball dead); the taker's next pass or shot is the kick. substitution: player_id leaves, related_player_id joins. injury / var_check: play is stopped. water_break_start / water_break_end: match-level, player_id null.

related_player_id.description: Second player involved, e.g. the player coming on in a substitution

amends.description: Id of an earlier event this one corrects (triggers re-resolve)
